scope: First-party review of 12 active catalog entries from the 2026-09-14 catalog wave; one superseded Databricks label was replaced with the current product identity.

accepted.name: Kiro
accepted.userValue: Kiro combines an AI coding environment with spec-based requirements, repository steering and event-triggered hooks across its supported development surfaces.

accepted.name: Letta
accepted.userValue: Letta provides stateful agents whose memory, tools and conversation history persist across sessions and can run locally or in cloud computers.

accepted.name: Langroid
accepted.userValue: Langroid gives Python developers explicit Agent and Task abstractions for orchestrating LLM conversations, tools, memory and vector-store-backed retrieval.

accepted.name: MetaGPT
accepted.userValue: MetaGPT turns natural-language software requirements into coordinated outputs such as user stories, architecture, APIs and code through specialized agent roles.

accepted.name: smolagents
accepted.userValue: smolagents provides a compact Python API for tool-using agents, including CodeAgent and ToolCallingAgent patterns and Hugging Face Hub integrations.

accepted.name: Salesforce Agentforce
accepted.userValue: Agentforce lets Salesforce teams build and deploy agents with platform actions, APIs, SDKs and governed access to business data.

accepted.name: Databricks Genie Agents
accepted.userValue: Genie Agents provide a governed natural-language interface to curated Databricks datasets, with data teams defining trusted assets, instructions and business context.

accepted.name: Snowflake Cortex
accepted.userValue: Snowflake Cortex brings AI functions, Cortex Search and Cortex Agents into Snowflake so teams can analyze structured and unstructured data in their governed environment.

accepted.name: Tableau Pulse
accepted.userValue: Tableau Pulse proactively surfaces relevant changes in followed metrics and provides guided questions, visual explanations and AI-generated summaries.

accepted.name: Qlik Answers
accepted.userValue: Qlik Answers lets business users ask questions across structured Qlik applications and curated document knowledge bases while exposing the sources behind responses.

accepted.name: Nanonets
accepted.userValue: Nanonets agents read business documents, apply explicit business rules, route uncertain cases for review and write structured results into systems of record.

accepted.name: HubSpot Breeze
accepted.userValue: Breeze Assistant uses HubSpot CRM context to help teams create and update records and carry out marketing, sales and service workflows inside HubSpot.

renamed.reason: The former product URL now redirects to the Genie Agents destination; current Databricks documentation identifies Genie Agents as the domain-specific conversational analytics interface.

notes: Every accepted entry has first-party product or documentation evidence and a concrete user-value statement.
No popularity, traffic, ranking, revenue or adoption claims were used as acceptance evidence.
Databricks Genie was recorded as rejected/superseded so the previous identity cannot silently reappear.
